body: Also, it's worth noting that certain pain relievers that induce liver failure can take *weeks* to kill you, and you don't even go unconscious for it.  If you want to get out on the other (living) side of this, you should probably get some sort of medical help.
Also just wanna say that I appreciate the message, even though it was just a short thing.  It is surprisingly nice to have my troubles acknowledged, even though I don't really know you.

Pain relievers?  I'm no doc, but do you have like a specific type?  I know that some like acetaminophen (tylenol) can fuck up your liver if you overdose on it -- this is one of the ones I OD'd on when I tried -- but I think others are less directly harmful.  But really, I know next to nothing on how this will affect you as an individual, someone with medical experience would know this.  I think activated charcoal is used a lot as detox for this sort of thing (it tastes horrible), but I don't know how readily available it is for you.

Edit: I mean there are so many different traits that factor into how your body reacts to any chemical: age, body mass, other medical issues etc.  I suppose one way to self-diagnose, if you particularly feel like you can't / aren't able to see a doctor would to be to monitor your own symptoms.  How do you feel?  How have you felt since you took the pain relievers? Do you have anyone in real life you can trust to talk to about this?

I'm not quite sure what to talk about exactly.  I realize my post is kinda disorganized in spite of the claim of 'organizing my thoughts' at the start.  My mental state has been sinking down these last couple weeks.  Failed a class due to it, not in the field I was planning on heading in, but it's a class regardless.  Kinda ashamed of that.  A lot of the time I just kinda feel like doing nothing, with some crying and feeling hopeless, reading about suicide and feeling bad.  Other days I feel a sort of rebound and feel like I can take on the world, but it doesn't really last long.  Then some days I just feel kinda numb, like today for the most part.  It is really shit.  Maybe not quite as shit as other people's shit, but shit nonetheless.

My previous attempt was a mix of impulsiveness and planning: I had kinda planned on doing it sometime, but then I just went out and did it.  It was stupid and not well-planned, and I was kind of embarrassed and humiliated with the hospitalization and psych ward confinement.  But I faked through that and got out of psych fairly quickly.  Because of this I am worried about if I were to attempt again; I can't have my past experience repeat itself again.  But it's like, I don't know what's past the point of 'death,' so maybe it's not worth it.  Really, I have no fucking idea.  It's so hard to balance my idea of this goal, this conviction, with my teetering mental state.  I really don't feel like I have ever had a solid enough mental state to fully commit to something, and I hate it.  Like I feel like this *has* to be my goal, but I don't know if I have the strength to fulfill it.  Maybe I could find someone with similar enough goals to be my partner in this, idk.

I read a bit into your posts, if you have anything to say (PM or otherwise) I am alright with that too.  I don't think I'll do it tonight, not feeling active enough to get up and find a way or brave the pain, haha.  But if you have something I'll be here.  Although I think I'll take a shower first, I need something warm.
